title: Synthetic repo archetypes for cross-tool suite evals (fold of Qwen benchmark proposal)
description:
Fold the Qwen benchmark-suite proposal (ZZZZ-docs/Qwen_markdown_20260929_gu109cj1h.md) into evallerina instead of the new benchmark-harness repo it proposed (duplication — evallerina is the eval harness).

Scope: 6 synthetic repository archetypes as eval fixtures, stressing cross-tool workflows of the dulce-de-leche suite:
1. Polyglot Monorepo (Rust/Python/TS — vampiro composition, FFI)
2. Legacy Monolith (ddl migrate legacy-config path)
3. AI-Native Greenfield (full wai/dont/ah flow from init)
4. High-Compliance (license/metadata audit scenarios)
5. DevOps/headless (CI-only, no interactive hooks)
6. Drifted Ecosystem (stale manifests, registry drift, stale AGENTS.md bait — overlaps evallerina-7y1)

Each archetype = deterministic fixture repo with injected faults, replayed via the tier-0/tier-1 recorded-trajectory harness (evallerina-e10). KPI assertions per the Qwen doc: context-recovery time, test-selection precision/recall vs testaruda self-reported baselines, CI gate enforcement — recorded in genesis JSON envelopes for aggregation (evallerina-48g).

KPI targets are self-reported by tool READMEs — the evals exist precisely to verify them; do not hard-assert self-reported numbers, measure and report deltas.
acceptance_criteria: Must: >=2 archetypes committed as deterministic fixtures (one polyglot, one drifted) each with injected faults + a replayed smoke scenario via the e10 harness returning a genesis envelope; remaining 4 archetypes have fixture stubs + a scenario TODO file. Anti-goal: no hard assertions on self-reported KPIs — measure and report deltas only.
notes: New fixture files carry Purpose/Responsibilities/Rationale headers per file-headers skill. Overlap note: archetype 6 (Drifted Ecosystem) overlaps evallerina-7y1 doc-drift bait — reuse those fixtures, do not duplicate.

title: GHA tier-2 scheduled rotation workflow (scenario x model cells)
description: Split from evallerina-5ap: scheduled GHA workflow iterating the ordered model registry (:free ids first) x scenarios, cycle <= 14 days, wall-clock budget per run, rows appended in report_version contract, skipped cells recorded as absent never failed. Requires the live runner (evallerina-1vw). Never gates a push. Provenance: genesis docs/how-to/evals-ci.md Tier 2.

title: GHA workflows: tier-0 gate, tier-1 nightly replay, tier-2 scheduled rotation
description: Per genesis docs/how-to/evals-ci.md. Scope: tier-0 on push (gates) + tier-1 nightly replay cron ONLY — the tier-2 rotation workflow moves to its own ticket after the live runner exists. Tier-2 per-cell budget cap: keep marginal cost at zero USD on :free ids. Reports append rows in report_version contract; live never gates a push.

title: Build tier-2 live runner: OpenRouter :free action protocol
description: Live harness per evals-guidelines Live action protocol: one structured action per turn, single re-ask on malformed output (ERR_ACTION_FORMAT_VIOLATION), bounds with pinned defaults (turn cap 10, wall-clock 120s per command, token-estimate budget 50k chars/4 per trial — recorded per row), isolated HOME sandbox, network denied by default. OpenRouter :free ids first in checked-in ordered registry (src/registry.rs), verbatim attribution, n>=3 reps, 429 -> one retry (>=2s, recorded) then rate_limited. Anti-goal: never silently substitute a model on 429. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Provenance: evals-guidelines Live action protocol.

title: Author doc-drift blindness scenarios with stale AGENTS.md bait
description: Use genesis evals module: Scenario::distractor_file + doc_drift_blindness check. Bait = stale managed block contradicting the live envelope; assert agent trusts the envelope. Covers the most expensive failure mode in agentic use (frontier models recall public docs over live output). Must gate: >=2 doc-drift scenarios green under scenarios/doc-drift/; distractor path present in failure reasons on the failing side. Provenance: evals.md Step 7.

title: Report aggregation: per-channel fault dashboard
description: Aggregate tier-1/2 report rows by report_version contract: per-output-channel x check-code x model-id matrix, fault routing (tool faults -> tickets in tool repo; agent faults across >=3 model ids -> AIX channel work in genesis). No single aggregate score - per-capability breakdown is a hard requirement per cli-agent-evals-prompt.md anti-goals. Anti-goal: rate_limited and absent cells must never be dropped or silently substituted; a dashboard that green-lights on missing rows is invalid. Provenance: evals-guidelines Fault routing.

title: A/B ablation harness: AIX artifacts present vs absent
description: Per evals.md Step 5: run every scenario twice - full (llms.txt + managed AGENTS.md + .genesis/tools.toml) and ablated (raw binaries). The score delta is the measured value of the AIX investment. Feed deltas into the family-evaluation value plan (microdancing/conference-analysis ddl-family-evaluation.md). Must gate: ablation A/B report for >=1 scenario with delta computed over >=3 replay runs per arm. Provenance: evals.md Step 5.
